item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! Happy weekend! A whole day to play. Here's your weather for Sunday, October 11. Sunday. A slow and cosy sort of day. Today in Shanghai, it will be wall to wall sunshine. The high will be 26 degrees, and the low will be 19 degrees. A warm one, but nothing too fierce. The chance of rain is 10 percent. Here's something to notice: today is almost exactly as warm as yesterday. Two days the same in a row! A great day for the garden, or for drawing with chalk outside. And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be overcast, with a high of 26 degrees. A question for you: what made you laugh yesterday? And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
